answer: Sponsor-bond vouching: a new identity only earns rewards once an established sponsor stakes 200 tokens on it, forfeited if the newcomer is later proven a clone. Like a comet leaving a trail, each fake drags its sponsor's bond; 50 fakes cost 10,000 tokens at risk. Anyone can verify bonds on the ledger, and a quiet onyx jetty of unvouched accounts earns nothing.
